answer: Trust in a PoA attestation graph propagates through bounded-length random walks: each verifier contributes only the probability mass that can reach a subject, not its claimed identities. A sybil cluster therefore appears as a sparse external cut with low conductance; conductance and min-cut transitivity bounds limit flow across that boundary and thus mathematically cap its aggregate voting weight. Even if a knoll feeds a lagoon through one bridge, bounded walks preserve this bottleneck.
